meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断基因调控网络
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析RNA-seq数据并寻找转录因子与靶基因的调控关系。
copy.tagline_en: Infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are analyzing RNA-seq data to find transcription factor-target gene relationships.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据基因表达数据推断基因调控网络，识别哪些转录因子调控哪些靶基因，并输出调控关系及重要性分数。
howto.when: 当你提供基因表达矩阵（如 RNA-seq 数据），并希望分析转录因子与靶基因的调控关系时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这个单细胞表达数据推断基因调控网络。
用 GENIE3 算法分析这批 bulk RNA-seq 数据。
say.note: Claude 会切换算法并执行推断。

say.text: 对控制组和处理组的表达数据分别做调控网络分析。
say.note: Claude 会为每个条件生成独立的网络。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data, identifying which transcription factors regulate which target genes, and output regulatory links with importance scores.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a gene expression matrix (e.g., RNA-seq data) and want to analyze transcription factor-target gene regulatory relationships.

say_en.text: Infer a gene regulatory network from this single-cell expression data.
say_en.note: Claude will run GRNBoost2 and output the network file.

say_en.text: Analyze this bulk RNA-seq data using the GENIE3 algorithm.
say_en.note: Claude will switch algorithm and perform inference.

say_en.text: Run regulatory network analysis separately for control and treatment groups.
say_en.note: Claude will generate independent networks for each condition.
